gaps.sentence: I ___ seeing that man somewhere before.
The two leaders signed a ___ peace agreement.
gaps.hint: important enough to be remembered in history
gaps.explanation: 'Historic' means important or famous in history; 'historical' just means connected with the past or the study of history.

gaps.sentence: He ___ her on her presentation and her handling of questions.
It would be ___ to take an umbrella — the sky is black.
gaps.explanation: 'Sensible' means showing good judgement; 'sensitive' means easily affected by things or feelings.

gaps.sentence: Factory workers are paid ___ at the end of each week.
gaps.hint: pay for manual work, usually weekly
gaps.explanation: 'Wages' are paid weekly, often in cash, for manual or unskilled work; salaries are monthly.
'Your' shows possession; 'you're' means 'you are'; 'yours' is a possessive pronoun standing alone.
'Complement' means to combine well with or complete something; 'compliment' means to praise.
'Valuable' means worth a lot of money; 'valued' means appreciated; 'invaluable' already means priceless, so it is not graded.
